_rule_no_new_slogans: EVERY headline on /story is copied VERBATIM from an existing approved surface — the /invest contracts, the Doctrine, or an approved external framing. The `source` field on each section is the binding citation. Grok must never author, improve, or vary a headline. Functional labels (nav, buttons) are exempt but must stay plain (Contact, Watch, Read).
_rule_arc: Chapter arc mirrors /invest: thesis -> proof -> product -> dual-use -> network vision -> films/press -> contact. /story is the public top of the ladder (/story -> /teaser -> /invest): no round, no valuations, no pipeline entity names, no energy/sea-grid content, no unit economics. Forwarded-to-a-competitor test governs every line.
_rule_visual: Visual-first: every chapter is anchored by real photography or film. FILMED/RENDER badge on every visual. Ambient loops muted autoplay <=15s; films click-to-play with poster frames. Text never sits on photo background. Article links render as press cards (outlet wordmark + verbatim headline + external link).
